newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Transportation names Sorci pres/COO.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Transportation names Sorci pres/COO.

text.p: U.S. Transportation Systems Inc said Monday it had named Ronald Sorci to the posts of president and chief operating officer, effective August 1.
Sorci replaces Michael Margolies as president. Company officials were not able to provide information on who the previous COO was.
Margolies remains chairman and chief executive officer.
Sorci joined the company in July 1996 as treasurer and controller.
A company spokeswoman said the COO and president positions had bewen vacant since May 1995.
Margolies had filled the presidentcy on a temporary basis.
